newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-MONACO SIGN DIAVARA, MAY RELEASE PETIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO SIGN DIAVARA, MAY RELEASE PETIT.

text.p: French champions Monaco signed young stopper Djibril Diawara from Le Havre on Friday and also said their veteran defender Emmanuel Petit was on the point of joining Valencia of Spain.
"That should be done very quickly, we've had to call Emmanuel who was on holiday and the contacts between the three parties could conclude any time," club manager Henri Biancheri said.

"Valencia are offering our player a contract of four years and it's a contract that's going to be quite high and no doubt above that of (midfielder) Moussa Saib whom they bought (from Auxerre) for 21 million francs ($3.5 million)."
Dakar-born Diawara, 22, joined Le Havre in 1991 and made his first division debut against Lille in November 1994.
